name: The $1,000,000 Jump Rope
desc:
🦑 Welcome to the $1,000,000 Jump Rope! 🦑  
Can you survive the Squid Game jump rope challenge from Season 3?

🏆 Team up with friends to stay alive longer!  
🎯 Time your jumps or fall like Jack and Jill!  
⚠️ In Dongdaemun, one mistake ends it all!

👍 Like and ⭐️ join the group for exclusive rewards!
